verdict.rationale: Gemini Apps documents a first-party Deep Research feature for in-depth, real-time research. It uses Google Search by default and can add Gmail, Drive, uploaded files and NotebookLM notebooks as sources, which covers launching a multi-source research run. However, the evidence never describes the output as a report or says it includes citations. Missing for 10: documentation that the run returns a structured report with source citations, explicit description of autonomous multi-step searching, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can launch a deep research run that autonomously searches many sources and returns a cited report

citations.quote: You can conduct in-depth and real-time research on almost any subject with Deep Research in Gemini Apps.
By default, Gemini includes Google Search as a source for your research. You can change or add other sources, like your personal Gmail or Drive.
You can also upload files and add NotebookLM notebooks.
